lines.text: Ha! You win, Jasper! Even the goat in a coat is cheering!
lines.speaker: horntail

lines.text: Ha! You win! Even the goat in a coat is cheering!
lines.speaker: horntail

lines.text: The egg opens… a boat! Your next task is at the lake.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Gulp! You eat the gillyweed… and grow flippers! Down into the Black Lake!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Oooh, a visitor! Hee hee! Your friend is down here. Follow me!
lines.speaker: myrtle

lines.text: Uh-oh! A cheeky grindylow tugs your flipper! Here… have a boot and a book!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Listen! The merpeople are singing. And look… your friend is tied to that statue!
lines.speaker: myrtle

lines.text: You lift the weedy rope off the hook. Your friend is free!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Grab the broom… and zoom up to the moon!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Oooh, you did it, Jasper! Everyone’s cheering… even me!
lines.speaker: myrtle

lines.text: Oooh, you did it! Everyone’s cheering… even me!
lines.speaker: myrtle

lines.text: Zap! The chain drops off the vault door… and in you creep.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ha ha! The golden cup is mine! Touch it… if you dare!
lines.speaker: bellatrix

lines.text: Pop, pop, pop! Cups everywhere! Which one is the real one?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ha! You’ll never find it. Never, ever, ever!
lines.speaker: bellatrix

lines.text: Oof! Who left a bar of soap on my floor?
lines.speaker: bellatrix

lines.text: Thank you, toad! Look… only the real cup is glowing!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hooray, Jasper! You found the golden cup!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hooray! You found the golden cup!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Here’s number eleven… and here’s number thirteen. But where is number twelve?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Woof! A big shaggy black dog bounds up… and licks your face!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ha! Fooled you! It’s only me, Sirius. Welcome to my house!
lines.speaker: sirius

lines.text: Uh-oh, we woke up the grumpy old portrait! Quick, Jasper, shut the curtains!
lines.speaker: sirius

lines.text: Uh-oh, we woke up the grumpy old portrait! Quick, shut the curtains!
lines.speaker: sirius

lines.text: Phew! Thank you. Now… who’s hungry? Dinner time!
lines.speaker: sirius

lines.text: Constant vigilance… and pass the jam!
lines.speaker: moody

lines.text: Clink, clink go the forks! Welcome to the Order of the Phoenix!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hello. The meadow is full of invisible creatures tonight. Try my spectrespecs!
lines.speaker: luna

lines.text: Floaty nargles… buzzy wrackspurts… and a crumple-horned snorkack! Isn’t he shy?
lines.speaker: luna

lines.text: Oh no! The cheeky nargles have pinched the crown and the coins!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Don’t worry. My lion hat will scare them off.
lines.speaker: luna

lines.text: Squeak! The hat has gone rusty. You drip on a little oil…
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: What a roar! Down drops the crown… right onto your head!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Thank you, Jasper. You’re very good at seeing things. Shall we dance?
lines.speaker: luna

lines.text: Thank you. You’re very good at seeing things. Shall we dance?
lines.speaker: luna

lines.text: A blank, boring wall… then a door rumbles out of nowhere!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The Room of Requirement! Cushions, books, and a chair!
lines.speaker: neville

lines.text: “Expelliarmus!” Whoops! Neville’s own wand flies up!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It’s stuck in my hair! Let me try again!
lines.speaker: neville

lines.text: Zing! This time it works! Everyone cheers!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now Patronuses! A silver stag, otter and hare gallop round!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Chair, hair, stairs, beard, letter: your words dance too!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: We did it, Jasper! Dumbledore would be so proud!
lines.speaker: neville

lines.text: We did it! Dumbledore would be so proud!
lines.speaker: neville

lines.text: The Room of Hidden Things! Junk is piled up high. Look, a toy shark and a hammer!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Shh… search quietly. That lost diadem must be in here somewhere…
lines.speaker: deatheater

lines.text: Two Death Eaters are searching! Tiptoe past them, nice and quietly…
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Uh-oh! They creep round the big pile from opposite sides…
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Oof! Ow! Watch where you’re going, you big lump!
lines.speaker: deatheater

lines.text: Bonk! They tumble into the junk, and a storm of old chairs falls down!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Look! The lost diadem sparkles on the statue’s head. Hooray, Jasper!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Look! The lost diadem sparkles on the statue’s head. Hooray!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You are in Professor Slughorn’s steamy potions dungeon. Time to stir the cauldron!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Golden and shining! My dear, that is Felix Felicis… liquid luck!
lines.speaker: slughorn

lines.text: You take one tiny sip… and feel wonderfully, brilliantly lucky!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Plop! A cake lands on a plate. And look, a kite floats past!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Splendid, Jasper! Crystallised pineapple? My favourite treat!
lines.speaker: slughorn

lines.text: Splendid! Crystallised pineapple? My favourite treat!
lines.speaker: slughorn

lines.text: Five stirs, one golden potion, and a very lucky day!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Waves crash on the tall, high cliff. Down below, there is a sea cave!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Follow me, Jasper. Some doors open only for a gentle touch.
lines.speaker: dumbledore

lines.text: Follow me. Some doors open only for a gentle touch.
lines.speaker: dumbledore

lines.text: He touches the cold rock… and a hidden arch glows open!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Beyond it, a dark lake lies still as glass. Drip… drip…
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ah! Our little boat. Hold the rope, and up she comes!
lines.speaker: dumbledore

lines.text: The boat glides to an island, and crystals light up like stars!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wonderful, isn’t it? Some places are just for wondering at.
lines.speaker: dumbledore

lines.text: You zoom up on your broom, through the fluffy clouds. Ginny flies beside you!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Watch this! Here goes the Quaffle…
lines.speaker: ginny

lines.text: Whoosh! Right through the hoop! The crowd cheers!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But a cheeky Bludger bounces about. Boing! Boing! Hee hee!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Look! The golden Snitch! Catch it, Jasper!
lines.speaker: ginny

lines.text: Look! The golden Snitch! Catch it!
lines.speaker: ginny

lines.text: You zig! You zag! Up, down, and… got it!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A tray, a pie, a leaf… the whole crowd is cheering for you!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You creep past a skull, a crow and a flame, into the spiky throne room.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Well, well… a little visitor! Who dares creep in here?
lines.speaker: nagini

lines.text: Hedwig hoots a soft, soft lullaby… and Nagini’s eyes go droopy.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Oh… so sleepy… so cosy… ahh…
lines.speaker: nagini

lines.text: She curls up in a big coil. Snore! Fast asleep, and not a bit hurt.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Look! A Horcrux glows on her. You tiptoe away, quiet as a mouse.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You peek into the old basement kitchen. It’s sparkling clean now!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Kreacher has been cooking all morning! Mind the flying pans!
lines.speaker: kreacher

lines.text: Sizzle, sizzle… ding! A golden pie pops out of the oven.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A pie for the picnic basket. Kreacher is very proud!
lines.speaker: kreacher

lines.text: Wait… the basket is wiggling! A rabbit and a kitten pop out!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Kreacher is happy to serve.
lines.speaker: kreacher

lines.text: You spread the carpet and share a yummy picnic. Hooray!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Griphook the goblin leads you to a tiny mine cart. Climb in!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hold on tight, Jasper! This cart goes very, very fast!
lines.speaker: griphook

lines.text: Hold on tight! This cart goes very, very fast!
lines.speaker: griphook

lines.text: Down, down, down you zoom, round twisty bends under the bank!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Here is the vault! Gold and helmets as far as you can see!
lines.speaker: griphook

lines.text: Look! A dragon! Don’t worry, he’s friendly, and he wants to be free!
lines.speaker: griphook

lines.text: You climb on his back… and he bursts up through the roof!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Over London you fly into the sunset. What a magic ride!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Back at Hogwarts, the sunset sky is dark. Thunder rolls over the courtyard!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Piertotum Locomotor!
lines.speaker: mcgonagall

lines.text: Stone knights creak awake! Stomp, stomp, stomp, they march out to guard the castle.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Oh, I’ve always wanted to use that spell!
lines.speaker: mcgonagall

lines.text: A shimmering shield rises over the castle, and the lanterns glow.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Get ready, Jasper… the battle is coming!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Get ready… the battle is coming!
lines.speaker: narrator
